S012.name: Feeling_Restless
S012.description: Often runs about or climbs in situations where it is inappropriate. (Note: In adolescents or adults, may be limited to feeling restless.)
examples: Feels uncomfortable and restless as if something is squirming inside when sitting still.
Feels internally anxious and stifled in situations requiring prolonged sitting.
A sense of urgency and anxiety that one must keep moving or doing something.
Feels unable to endure staying still and must constantly be doing something.

S013.name: Quiet_Activity_Difficulty
S013.description: Often unable to play or engage in leisure activities quietly.
examples: Unable to engage in calm activities for long, such as reading quietly or drawing.
Cannot play quietly, often shouting or making loud noises during games or play.
Unable to stay quiet in quiet places like libraries or movie theaters, making noise.
Cannot endure and avoids quiet and calm activities like meditation or yoga.

S014.name: Constant_Activity
S014.description: Is often 'on the go', acting as if 'driven by a motor'.
examples: Constantly moving and active as if driven by a motor.
Starts another task immediately after finishing one, without resting for a moment.
Unable to stay still even on weekends or days off, constantly doing something.
Appears to others to be always busy and bustling about.

S016.name: Blurting_Answers
S016.description: Often blurts out an answer before a question has been completed.
examples: Raises hand or blurts out the answer before the question is even finished in class or meetings.
Jumps to conclusions and speaks before the other person finishes their sentence.
Answers hastily without reading the question to the end in quizzes or exams.
Interrupts and answers in the middle of a conversation without listening to the other person until the end.

S017.name: Waiting_Turn_Difficulty
S017.description: Often has difficulty waiting his or her turn.
examples: Cannot wait and cuts in line or gets impatient when standing in a queue.
Rushes or cuts in without waiting for their turn in games or board games.
Keeps checking the time or complaining when waiting for their turn at hospitals or public offices.
Fidgets, complains, or gets annoyed in situations where waiting for a turn is required.

info.persona: Charles Hoff blends a structured, community‑focused work ethic with a chatty, worry‑prone personality that fuels their love for early‑morning fishing, meticulous inventory lists, and occasional indulgence in fried comfort foods, and they often joke about their own stubbornness.
info.professional_persona: Charles Hoff, a seasoned facilities and commercial cleaning specialist with three decades of experience, leverages meticulous inventory management, chemical safety expertise, and hands‑on repair skills while they use their talkative, community‑oriented nature to train staff and resolve occupant concerns with a blend of assertive guidance and friendly hospitality.
info.cultural_background: Raised in rural Amite County, Mississippi, Charles grew up in a working‑class, white Southern Baptist family that valued hard work, community service, and close family ties. He carries traditional Southern hospitality, a love for regional cuisine such as fried catfish and pecan pie, and a deep connection to local customs, including church picnics and county fairs. His cultural upbringing informs his respectful, yet assertive, interpersonal style and his commitment to contributing positively to his hometown.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Charles enjoys social gatherings at his local church and community center, where his talkative personality shines. He is an avid fisherman who spends early mornings on the nearby Pearl River, and he tends a modest garden that supplies fresh vegetables for family meals. He also likes woodworking projects, playing classic rock records, and participating in weekly bingo nights with his wife and friends.
info.sports_persona: Charles Hoff enjoys early‑morning fishing on the Pearl River, joins a local senior softball league each spring, and faithfully follows the New Orleans Saints, the Mississippi State Bulldogs football team, and the Mississippi Braves minor‑league baseball club, using these seasonal activities to stay active while they cherish the camaraderie of team sports.
info.arts_persona: Charles Hoff relaxes after work by spinning classic rock vinyls from Led Zeppelin, The Rolling Stones, and Lynyrd Skynyrd while they craft handmade wooden furniture that reflects the craftsmanship of local folk artist David 'Rattlesnake' Cobb, and they occasionally attend community theater productions starring regional actors like John Ridenour.
info.travel_persona: Charles Hoff prefers meticulously planned road trips that combine relaxed fishing charters on the Gulf Coast with cultural stops in New Orleans' French Quarter, the historic districts of Savannah, and the scenic vistas of the Great Smoky Mountains, always budgeting to keep family expenses in check while they balance adventure with comfort.
info.culinary_persona: Charles Hoff delights in cooking home‑grown collard greens, corn succotash, and perfectly seasoned fried catfish served with buttery biscuits, while they satisfy their sweet tooth by baking pecan pie using locally sourced pecans and a pinch of bourbon, showcasing solid comfort‑food kitchen skills.

info.persona: Cynthia Payton is a compassionate, art‑loving elder who balances spontaneous creativity with occasional anxiety, weaving community stories into watercolor skies and heartfelt memoirs.
info.professional_persona: An 87‑year‑old community volunteer, Cynthia Payton leverages empathetic listening, conflict mediation, and a keen eye for visual art to mentor younger volunteers, curate a senior‑focused art exhibit, and document neighborhood stories while learning digital photography for their forthcoming memoir.
info.cultural_background: Cynthia grew up in post‑World War II Oklahoma, raised in a Midwestern Protestant household that emphasized community service, modesty, and self‑reliance. The blend of Southern hospitality and Great Plains practicality in Oklahoma City shaped her love for pot‑luck gatherings, church‑based charity work, and open‑air celebrations. She embraces American folk traditions such as quilting and regional cuisine, while also holding deep respect for the Native American heritage present throughout the state. Her exposure to the social movements of the 1960s reinforced her commitment to compassion, harmony, and advocacy for the underserved, values that continue to guide her everyday interactions.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Cynthia finds joy in a variety of artistic and contemplative pursuits. She frequently visits Oklahoma City’s galleries and museums, soaking in new ideas. Her own watercolor paintings capture the changing skies of the plains, while quilting offers a tactile connection to tradition. She is an avid reader of historical fiction and biographies, often discussing books in her local book club. Gardening, especially growing native wildflowers and a modest vegetable patch, provides therapeutic solace. She loves listening to jazz and classic pop records, cooking cherished family recipes, and attending community theater productions. Volunteering to share stories with fellow seniors brings her a sense of purpose and connection.
info.sports_persona: Cynthia Payton enjoys gentle morning walks through their native wildflower garden, participates in a weekly senior yoga class, and rallies with friends to watch Oklahoma City Thunder games, while occasionally joining a community pickleball group for light exercise.
info.arts_persona: Cynthia Payton expresses their love of the arts through watercolor skies inspired by Monet, quilting patterns echoing regional folk motifs, attending community theater productions starring local talent, and listening to Miles Davis, Ella Fitzgerald, and The Beatles while discussing historical fiction with their book club.
info.travel_persona: Cynthia Payton prefers relaxed road trips to nearby destinations like the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge and Santa Fe’s International Folk Art Market, planning itineraries at a leisurely pace but sometimes impulsively detouring to a roadside historic museum when a vintage postcard catches their eye.
info.culinary_persona: Cynthia Payton delights in preparing family‑favorite chicken‑fried steak with creamy mashed potatoes, simmering garden‑fresh tomato soup seasoned with basil and thyme, and baking apple‑cinnamon crumble, while their modest cooking skill is matched by an adventurous palate for seasonal wildflower honey drizzles.

info.persona: Jorge Rosado is a detail‑obsessed 18‑year‑old radiology student who lives for late‑night sketch sessions, precise X‑ray images, and the occasional coffee‑stained notebook of poetry, all while juggling a secret stash of snack chips during study breaks.
info.professional_persona: Jorge Rosado is an emerging radiologic technologist who blends meticulous imaging expertise with a vivid artistic imagination, leveraging they bilingual fluency to improve patient communication and crafting visual educational tools that demystify complex scans.
info.cultural_background: Jorge was raised in a close‑knit Mexican‑American family in Stephenville, Texas, where Spanish is spoken at home and cultural traditions such as Día de los Muertos and family reunions are central to his identity. His parents instilled a strong work ethic and respect for education, encouraging him to pursue a career in health care. The bicultural environment shaped his bilingual communication skills and his sensitivity to the needs of Hispanic patients. He maintains ties to his heritage by attending local Hispanic community events, cooking traditional Mexican dishes, and supporting charitable initiatives that improve health access for underserved Latino populations.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his free time, Jorge indulges in creative pursuits that satisfy his curiosity for abstract concepts. He enjoys sketching and digital illustration, often blending anatomical motifs with surreal art. Photography, especially low‑light and macro work, lets him explore light and shadow—a skill he translates into his radiographic imaging practice. He is an avid reader of science‑fiction novels and philosophy, which fuels his imagination. Music provides another outlet; he plays acoustic guitar and writes simple melodies for personal relaxation. Jorge also participates in a small community book club and volunteers as a Spanish interpreter at local health fairs.
info.sports_persona: Jorge Rosado enjoys solo runs through the local park at sunrise, occasional pick‑up basketball games with the Eastside Hoops club, and follows the Chicago Bulls for basketball, the Los Angeles Dodgers for baseball, and the Seattle Sounders for soccer, using a habit‑forming fitness tracker to maintain a balanced routine that feels both meditative and energizing.
info.arts_persona: Jorge Rosado channels a fascination with surreal anatomy into intricate digital illustrations inspired by H.R. Giger and Salvador Dalí, captures low‑light street scenes reminiscent of Edward Hopper with a vintage Nikon D750, strums acoustic renditions of Bon Iver and The Beatles on guitar, and fuels their imagination with science‑fiction classics like Philip K. Dick’s 'Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?' and philosophical works by Nietzsche, all of which shape their creative identity.
info.travel_persona: Jorge Rosado prefers meticulously planned trips that mix low‑light photography opportunities with cultural immersion, so they have already documented the neon‑lit streets of Tokyo, explored the historic architecture of Granada, and dream of a sunrise hike to Machu Picchu to capture Andean clouds, while budgeting each journey through a student travel fund and often traveling with two close friends from their book club.
info.culinary_persona: Jorge Rosado cooks at an intermediate level, favoring dishes that blend bold flavors and visual flair such as cilantro‑lime grilled chicken tacos, shakshuka with feta, and homemade matcha latte, while their pantry staples include fresh avocados, quinoa, and dark chocolate, and they often experiment with plating techniques inspired by their illustration background.
